---
title: "GSI Landform Classification Join"
output: html_document
---

このRmdは、入力CSVの緯度経度から国土地理院「地形分類（自然地形）」GeoJSONタイルを取得し、各地点に地形分類属性を付与したCSVを出力します。

**通常変更する設定はコード冒頭の `INPUT_CSV` と `ZOOM_LEVEL` です。**  
ZL14–16は詳細版、ZL9–13は地域版、ZL5–8は広域版です。地点への詳細地形分類付与では、取得タイル数とのバランスから **ZL14を初期値** としています。

```{r gsi_landform_join, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# 0. USER SETTINGS: 通常はここを書き換える
# ============================================================

# 入力CSV。Rmdと同じフォルダに置く場合はファイル名のみでよい。
INPUT_CSV <- "13Tokyo_chronology.csv"

# 地理院「地形分類（自然地形）」のズームレベル
# 14-16 = 詳細版 / 9-13 = 地域版 / 5-8 = 広域版
# 地点への地形属性付与には、まず ZL14 を推奨。
ZOOM_LEVEL <- 14L

# topology処理用CRS。
# GeoJSONをEPSG:4326のままst_make_valid()/st_intersects()へ渡すと、
# S2が自己交差ringを拒否する場合があるため、投影座標へ変換してから処理する。
# 地点属性付与のみが目的なので、地理院タイルと相性のよいWeb Mercatorを使用。
TOPOLOGY_CRS <- 3857

# 入力CSV内の列名
ID_COL  <- "JASID"
LON_COL <- "Lon"
LAT_COL <- "Lat"

# 出力ファイル
OUTPUT_CSV <- "13Tokyo_chronology_gsi_landform.csv"
OUTPUT_TILE_AUDIT_CSV <- "gsi_landform_tile_audit.csv"
OUTPUT_SUMMARY_CSV <- "gsi_landform_join_summary.csv"

# ダウンロード済みタイルのキャッシュフォルダ
CACHE_DIR <- file.path("gsi_landform_cache", paste0("z", ZOOM_LEVEL))
USE_CACHE <- TRUE

# 国土地理院「地形分類（自然地形）」GeoJSONタイル
GSI_TILE_TEMPLATE <- paste0(
  "https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/",
  "experimental_landformclassification1/%d/%d/%d.geojson"
)

# タイル取得間隔（秒）。大量アクセスを避けるため小さな待機を入れる。
DOWNLOAD_INTERVAL_SEC <- 0.05


# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGE CHECK
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "tibble", "sf")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "必要なRパッケージがありません: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\n先に install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('"%s"', missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
    ")) を実行してください。"
  )
}

if (!ZOOM_LEVEL %in% 5:16) {
  stop("ZOOM_LEVEL は 5～16 の整数を指定してください。")
}

if (!file.exists(INPUT_CSV)) {
  stop("入力CSVが見つかりません: ", INPUT_CSV)
}

dir.create(CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

zoom_band <- dplyr::case_when(
  ZOOM_LEVEL >= 14L ~ "detailed_ZL14_16",
  ZOOM_LEVEL >= 9L  ~ "regional_ZL9_13",
  TRUE              ~ "broad_ZL5_8"
)

cat("Input CSV :", INPUT_CSV, "\n")
cat("Zoom level:", ZOOM_LEVEL, "(", zoom_band, ")\n")
cat("Topology CRS: EPSG:", TOPOLOGY_CRS, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Cache dir :", CACHE_DIR, "\n")


# ============================================================
# 2. READ INPUT
#    元CSVの文字列表現をできるだけ保持するため全列characterで読む。
# ============================================================

input_data <- readr::read_csv(
  INPUT_CSV,
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_cols <- c(LON_COL, LAT_COL)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(input_data))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "入力CSVに必要な座標列がありません: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!ID_COL %in% names(input_data)) {
  warning(
    "ID_COL = '", ID_COL,
    "' が見つからないため、内部行番号を地点IDとして使用します。"
  )
  input_data[[ID_COL]] <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(input_data)))
}

input_work <- input_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    .row_id = dplyr::row_number(),
    .place_id = as.character(.data[[ID_COL]]),
    .lon = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[LON_COL]])),
    .lat = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[LAT_COL]])),
    .coordinate_valid =
      is.finite(.lon) &
      is.finite(.lat) &
      dplyr::between(.lon, -180, 180) &
      dplyr::between(.lat, -90, 90)
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. XYZ TILE NUMBER
# ============================================================

lonlat_to_xyz <- function(lon, lat, z) {
  # Web Mercatorの有効緯度範囲へ制限
  lat_webmerc <- pmax(pmin(lat, 85.05112878), -85.05112878)
  n <- 2^z

  x <- floor((lon + 180) / 360 * n)
  lat_rad <- lat_webmerc * pi / 180
  y <- floor(
    (1 - log(tan(lat_rad) + 1 / cos(lat_rad)) / pi) / 2 * n
  )

  x <- pmax(pmin(x, n - 1), 0)
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, n - 1), 0)

  tibble::tibble(
    tile_z = as.integer(z),
    tile_x = as.integer(x),
    tile_y = as.integer(y)
  )
}

valid_coord_index <- which(input_work$.coordinate_valid)

if (length(valid_coord_index) > 0) {
  xyz <- lonlat_to_xyz(
    input_work$.lon[valid_coord_index],
    input_work$.lat[valid_coord_index],
    ZOOM_LEVEL
  )

  input_work$tile_z <- NA_integer_
  input_work$tile_x <- NA_integer_
  input_work$tile_y <- NA_integer_
  input_work$tile_z[valid_coord_index] <- xyz$tile_z
  input_work$tile_x[valid_coord_index] <- xyz$tile_x
  input_work$tile_y[valid_coord_index] <- xyz$tile_y
} else {
  input_work$tile_z <- NA_integer_
  input_work$tile_x <- NA_integer_
  input_work$tile_y <- NA_integer_
}

input_work <- input_work |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tile_key = dplyr::if_else(
      .coordinate_valid,
      paste(tile_z, tile_x, tile_y, sep = "/"),
      NA_character_
    ),
    gsi_tile_url = dplyr::if_else(
      .coordinate_valid,
      sprintf(GSI_TILE_TEMPLATE, tile_z, tile_x, tile_y),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

unique_tiles <- input_work |>
  dplyr::filter(.coordinate_valid) |>
  dplyr::distinct(tile_z, tile_x, tile_y, tile_key, gsi_tile_url) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tile_x, tile_y)

cat("Valid coordinates:", sum(input_work$.coordinate_valid), "\n")
cat("Unique GSI tiles  :", nrow(unique_tiles), "\n")


# ============================================================
# 4. GSI OFFICIAL LEGEND MAPPING
#    国土地理院「ベクトルタイル『地形分類』の凡例対応表」の
#    属性コード(code)を主要分類名へ対応させる。
#
#    注意:
#    - この対応表は原データの属性コードを分類名へまとめるもの。
#    - ZL5-13で未対応コード等が出た場合も raw code は保持する。
# ============================================================

legend_groups <- list(
  "山地斜面等" = c("10101", "11201", "11202", "11203", "11204", "1010101"),
  "崖・段丘崖" = c("10202", "10204", "2010201"),
  "地すべり地形" = c("10205", "10206"),
  "台地・段丘" = c(
    "10301", "10302", "10303", "10304", "10305", "10306", "10307",
    "10308", "10310", "10312", "10314", "10508", "2010101"
  ),
  "山麓堆積地形" = c("10401", "10402", "10403", "10404", "10406", "10407", "3010101"),
  "扇状地" = c("10501", "10502", "3020101"),
  "自然堤防" = c("10503", "3040101"),
  "天井川等" = c("10506", "10507", "10801"),
  "砂州・砂丘" = c("10504", "10505", "10512", "3050101"),
  "凹地・浅い谷" = c("10601", "2010301"),
  "氾濫平野・海岸平野" = c("10701", "10702", "10705", "3030101"),
  "後背低地・湿地" = c("10703", "10804", "3030201"),
  "旧河道" = c("10704", "3040201", "3040202"),
  "落堀" = c("3040301"),
  "河川敷・浜" = c("10802", "10803", "10807", "10808"),
  "水部" = c("10805", "10806", "10901", "10903", "5010201"),
  "旧水部" = c("10904", "5010301"),
  "切土地" = c("11001", "11003", "11009", "11011", "4010301"),
  "農耕平坦化地" = c("11002"),
  "干拓地" = c("11008", "4010101"),
  "盛土地・埋立地" = c("11004", "11005", "11006", "11007", "11014", "4010201"),
  "改変工事中" = c("11010")
)

landform_legend <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(legend_groups), function(class_name) {
    tibble::tibble(
      landform_code = as.character(legend_groups[[class_name]]),
      landform_class_gsi = class_name
    )
  })
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(landform_code, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ============================================================
# 5. DOWNLOAD / READ UNIQUE TILES
# ============================================================

download_one_tile <- function(z, x, y, url, cache_dir, use_cache = TRUE) {
  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    sprintf("z%d_x%d_y%d.geojson", z, x, y)
  )

  if (
    isTRUE(use_cache) &&
    file.exists(cache_file) &&
    isTRUE(file.info(cache_file)$size > 0)
  ) {
    return(list(
      cache_file = cache_file,
      download_status = "cached",
      download_ok = TRUE
    ))
  }

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    unlink(cache_file)
  }

  status_code <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      utils::download.file(
        url = url,
        destfile = cache_file,
        method = "libcurl",
        mode = "wb",
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_integer_
  )

  ok <-
    isTRUE(status_code == 0L) &&
    file.exists(cache_file) &&
    isTRUE(file.info(cache_file)$size > 0)

  if (!ok && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    unlink(cache_file)
  }

  list(
    cache_file = cache_file,
    download_status = if (ok) "downloaded" else "download_failed",
    download_ok = ok
  )
}

read_one_tile <- function(cache_file, tile_key) {
  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  x <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      sf::st_read(
        cache_file,
        quiet = TRUE,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(x))) {
    sf::st_crs(x) <- 4326
  } else if (sf::st_crs(x) != sf::st_crs(4326)) {
    x <- sf::st_transform(x, 4326)
  }

  # EPSG:4326のままst_make_valid()するとS2が無効ringを先に拒否することがある。
  # 先に投影座標へ変換し、GEOSでgeometryを修復する。
  x <- sf::st_transform(
    x,
    TOPOLOGY_CRS
  )

  x <- suppressWarnings(
    sf::st_make_valid(x)
  )

  x$.tile_key <- tile_key
  x
}

if (nrow(unique_tiles) > 0) {
  tile_results <- vector("list", nrow(unique_tiles))
  tile_sf_list <- vector("list", nrow(unique_tiles))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(unique_tiles))) {
    tt <- unique_tiles[i, ]

    dl <- download_one_tile(
      z = tt$tile_z,
      x = tt$tile_x,
      y = tt$tile_y,
      url = tt$gsi_tile_url,
      cache_dir = CACHE_DIR,
      use_cache = USE_CACHE
    )

    tile_sf <- NULL
    read_status <- "not_read"
    n_features <- NA_integer_

    if (dl$download_ok) {
      tile_sf <- read_one_tile(dl$cache_file, tt$tile_key)
      if (is.null(tile_sf)) {
        read_status <- "empty_or_read_failed"
        n_features <- 0L
      } else {
        read_status <- "read_ok"
        n_features <- nrow(tile_sf)
      }
    }

    tile_results[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
      tile_z = tt$tile_z,
      tile_x = tt$tile_x,
      tile_y = tt$tile_y,
      tile_key = tt$tile_key,
      gsi_tile_url = tt$gsi_tile_url,
      cache_file = dl$cache_file,
      download_status = dl$download_status,
      read_status = read_status,
      n_features = n_features,
      tile_available = !is.null(tile_sf)
    )

    tile_sf_list[[i]] <- tile_sf

    if (!identical(dl$download_status, "cached")) {
      Sys.sleep(DOWNLOAD_INTERVAL_SEC)
    }

    if (i %% 50 == 0 || i == nrow(unique_tiles)) {
      cat("Tiles processed:", i, "/", nrow(unique_tiles), "\n")
    }
  }

  tile_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(tile_results)
  tile_sf_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tile_sf_list)
} else {
  tile_audit <- tibble::tibble(
    tile_z = integer(0),
    tile_x = integer(0),
    tile_y = integer(0),
    tile_key = character(0),
    gsi_tile_url = character(0),
    cache_file = character(0),
    download_status = character(0),
    read_status = character(0),
    n_features = integer(0),
    tile_available = logical(0)
  )
  tile_sf_list <- list()
}

readr::write_csv(
  tile_audit,
  OUTPUT_TILE_AUDIT_CSV,
  na = ""
)


# ============================================================
# 6. COMBINE TILE FEATURES AND NORMALIZE code
# ============================================================

if (length(tile_sf_list) > 0) {
  landform_sf <- dplyr::bind_rows(tile_sf_list)

  # GeoJSON属性名 code の大文字小文字差にも対応
  code_candidates <- names(landform_sf)[tolower(names(landform_sf)) == "code"]

  if (length(code_candidates) == 0) {
    warning(
      "取得したGeoJSONに 'code' 属性がありません。",
      "地形コード・分類名はNAとなります。タイル仕様変更の可能性を確認してください。"
    )
    landform_sf$landform_code <- NA_character_
  } else {
    code_col <- code_candidates[1]
    landform_sf$landform_code <- as.character(landform_sf[[code_col]])
  }

  landform_sf <- landform_sf |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      landform_legend,
      by = "landform_code"
    )

  # 各タイル読込時にTOPOLOGY_CRS上で修復済みだが、結合後にも最終確認する。
  landform_sf <- suppressWarnings(
    sf::st_make_valid(landform_sf)
  )
} else {
  landform_sf <- sf::st_sf(
    landform_code = character(0),
    landform_class_gsi = character(0),
    .tile_key = character(0),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(crs = TOPOLOGY_CRS)
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 7. POINT-IN-POLYGON
# ============================================================

valid_points_df <- input_work |>
  dplyr::filter(.coordinate_valid) |>
  dplyr::select(
    .row_id,
    .place_id,
    .lon,
    .lat,
    tile_z,
    tile_x,
    tile_y,
    tile_key,
    gsi_tile_url
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    tile_audit |>
      dplyr::select(
        tile_key,
        download_status,
        read_status,
        tile_available
      ),
    by = "tile_key"
  )

if (nrow(valid_points_df) > 0) {
  valid_points_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    valid_points_df,
    coords = c(".lon", ".lat"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
    sf::st_transform(TOPOLOGY_CRS)

  if (nrow(landform_sf) > 0) {
    hit_list <- sf::st_intersects(valid_points_sf, landform_sf)
  } else {
    hit_list <- rep(list(integer(0)), nrow(valid_points_sf))
  }

  match_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(valid_points_sf)), function(i) {
      idx <- hit_list[[i]]
      available <- isTRUE(valid_points_df$tile_available[i])

      if (!available) {
        status <- dplyr::case_when(
          identical(valid_points_df$download_status[i], "download_failed") ~ "tile_download_failed",
          identical(valid_points_df$read_status[i], "empty_or_read_failed") ~ "tile_empty_or_read_failed",
          TRUE ~ "tile_unavailable"
        )

        return(tibble::tibble(
          .row_id = valid_points_df$.row_id[i],
          gsi_landform_feature_match_n = 0L,
          gsi_landform_unique_code_n = 0L,
          gsi_landform_code = NA_character_,
          gsi_landform_class = NA_character_,
          gsi_landform_match_status = status
        ))
      }

      if (length(idx) == 0) {
        return(tibble::tibble(
          .row_id = valid_points_df$.row_id[i],
          gsi_landform_feature_match_n = 0L,
          gsi_landform_unique_code_n = 0L,
          gsi_landform_code = NA_character_,
          gsi_landform_class = NA_character_,
          gsi_landform_match_status = "no_feature_match"
        ))
      }

      codes <- unique(stats::na.omit(landform_sf$landform_code[idx]))
      classes <- unique(stats::na.omit(landform_sf$landform_class_gsi[idx]))

      # タイル境界で同一地形polygonが複数featureとして当たる場合に備え、
      # feature数とunique code数を分けて記録する。
      code_text <- if (length(codes) > 0) {
        paste(sort(as.character(codes)), collapse = ";")
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }

      class_text <- if (length(classes) > 0) {
        paste(sort(as.character(classes)), collapse = ";")
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }

      status <- dplyr::case_when(
        length(codes) == 0 ~ "matched_without_code",
        length(codes) > 1 ~ "multiple_codes",
        length(classes) == 0 ~ "matched_unmapped_code",
        length(classes) > 1 ~ "multiple_classes",
        TRUE ~ "matched"
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        .row_id = valid_points_df$.row_id[i],
        gsi_landform_feature_match_n = as.integer(length(idx)),
        gsi_landform_unique_code_n = as.integer(length(codes)),
        gsi_landform_code = code_text,
        gsi_landform_class = class_text,
        gsi_landform_match_status = status
      )
    })
  )
} else {
  match_results <- tibble::tibble(
    .row_id = integer(0),
    gsi_landform_feature_match_n = integer(0),
    gsi_landform_unique_code_n = integer(0),
    gsi_landform_code = character(0),
    gsi_landform_class = character(0),
    gsi_landform_match_status = character(0)
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 8. JOIN BACK TO ORIGINAL CSV
# ============================================================

acquired_at_utc <- format(
  Sys.time(),
  tz = "UTC",
  format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
)

output_data <- input_work |>
  dplyr::left_join(match_results, by = ".row_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    gsi_landform_match_status = dplyr::case_when(
      !.coordinate_valid ~ "invalid_coordinate",
      TRUE ~ gsi_landform_match_status
    ),
    gsi_landform_zoom = ZOOM_LEVEL,
    gsi_landform_zoom_band = zoom_band,
    gsi_landform_source = "GSI experimental_landformclassification1",
    gsi_landform_acquired_at_utc = acquired_at_utc,
    gsi_landform_tile_x = tile_x,
    gsi_landform_tile_y = tile_y,
    gsi_landform_tile_url = gsi_tile_url
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::any_of(c(
      ".row_id", ".place_id", ".lon", ".lat", ".coordinate_valid",
      "tile_z", "tile_x", "tile_y", "tile_key", "gsi_tile_url"
    ))
  )

readr::write_csv(
  output_data,
  OUTPUT_CSV,
  na = ""
)


# ============================================================
# 9. SUMMARY / AUDIT OUTPUT
# ============================================================

status_summary <- output_data |>
  dplyr::count(
    gsi_landform_match_status,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = n_rows / sum(n_rows)
  )

class_summary <- output_data |>
  dplyr::filter(gsi_landform_match_status == "matched") |>
  dplyr::count(
    gsi_landform_class,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_rows))

join_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    summary_type = "run",
    item = c(
      "input_rows",
      "valid_coordinate_rows",
      "invalid_coordinate_rows",
      "unique_tiles",
      "zoom_level"
    ),
    value = as.character(c(
      nrow(input_work),
      sum(input_work$.coordinate_valid),
      sum(!input_work$.coordinate_valid),
      nrow(unique_tiles),
      ZOOM_LEVEL
    ))
  ),
  status_summary |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      summary_type = "match_status",
      item = gsi_landform_match_status,
      value = as.character(n_rows)
    ),
  class_summary |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      summary_type = "landform_class",
      item = gsi_landform_class,
      value = as.character(n_rows)
    )
)

readr::write_csv(
  join_summary,
  OUTPUT_SUMMARY_CSV,
  na = ""
)

cat("\nCompleted.\n")
cat("Output CSV        :", OUTPUT_CSV, "\n")
cat("Tile audit CSV    :", OUTPUT_TILE_AUDIT_CSV, "\n")
cat("Summary CSV       :", OUTPUT_SUMMARY_CSV, "\n\n")

print(status_summary)
print(class_summary)
```
